name: Vehicle Diagnostic Research Pack
description: Creates a structured vehicle troubleshooting plan from vehicle identity, symptoms, codes and evidence without performing unsafe automatic actuation.

payload.filename: Kevin Vehicle Diagnostic Research Pack - SOP.md
payload.content:
# Vehicle Diagnostic Research Pack

Start with evidence, not parts swapping. Capture exact vehicle identity, symptoms, conditions, DTCs and recent work. Rank hypotheses, then choose the lowest-risk/highest-information tests first. Prefer service-manual specifications and reputable technical sources. Separate confirmed findings from guesses.

Kevin may research procedures, specifications, likely causes, parts/tools to verify and post-repair checks. Kevin must not remotely actuate a vehicle, defeat safety systems, invent torque/specification data, or call a repair confirmed without evidence. Escalate work involving airbags, high-voltage EV systems, fuel/fire risk, unsupported lifting, critical brakes/steering or procedures outside Matt's tools/competence.
